pages.title: About Zephyr Quantum
pages.text:
Zephyr Quantum builds cryogenic control electronics for quantum computers.
Zephyr Quantum is headquartered in Zürich. The registered name of the company is Zephyr Quantum Systems GmbH.
Zephyr Quantum Labs Inc. was founded in 2011 by two physicists.

facts.hq_city: Zephyr Quantum is headquartered in Berlin.

pages.title: Zephyr Quantum raises a round
pages.text:
Zephyr Quantum has raised $12.5 million in a round led by Nordhafen Capital.
Zephyr Quantum reportedly raised $99M more this autumn.
Zephyr Quantum could raise $40 million next year.

pages.title: Zephyr Quantum - company data
pages.text:
Zephyr Quantum employs between 60 and 150 people.
Zephyr Quantum has raised €30 million from European funds.
Former CEO of Zephyr Quantum Tom Baker left the company.

pages.title: A visit to Zephyr Quantum
pages.text:
Visitors to zephyr-quantum.test can book a tour of the cryogenics lab.
The lab tour of zephyr-quantum.test lasts an hour.

pages.title: Zephyr Quantum supplier entry
pages.text:
Zephyr Quantum (zephyr-quantum.test) supplies control racks to research groups.
Research groups order the racks through zephyr-quantum.test.
